desc: Baseline + three-way A/B with debug dumps. At the parked vantage capture three screenshots via ./scripts/run.sh play screenshot (TERM set, ENGINE_HIDE_GUI=1, ENGINE_SCREENSHOT_DELAY_MS=6000, ENGINE_DEBUG_DUMP_IMAGES=gi,giEstimate,ao, 6s settle): (a) OFF = ENGINE_GI_DISABLED=1, (b) ON = default, (c) ON_AO1 = ON + ENGINE_GI_AO_SCALE=1.0 (exact OFF CACAO state). Compute the 6x6 diff grid + per-channel box means for the four artifact regions (player halo, eave band + roof apex, cyan mid-wall, wall-ground contact line) for BOTH diffs (ON-OFF and ON_AO1-OFF); confirm the plan's measured values still reproduce. Append to notes.md: box coordinates, both sets of box means, where the ao/gi/giEstimate dumps show structure, and the artifact -> {AO-coupling / GI-march / temporal / physically-intended} attribution table.
result: Three-way A/B + gi/giEstimate/ao dumps captured at the parked vantage (2880x1627); all four artifacts structurally reproduce at ~0.6x the plan's magnitude. Attribution: eave band ~75% GI-march / ~25% AO; halo 100% GI-march (present in raw estimate, ~22% ambient drop, likely partly intended character occlusion); cyan cast 100% GI-mix; roof apex ~100% and wall-ground contact line ~85% AO-coupled. Full box means + table in notes.md.

desc: Temporal split (from brainstorm). Re-run the default ON — and ON_AO1 if the eave band survives AO isolation — with ENGINE_GI_TEMPORAL=0 plus the same ENGINE_DEBUG_DUMP_IMAGES=gi,giEstimate,ao. Classify the halo, eave band, and cyan cast by whether each appears in the raw giEstimate dump (march bug) or only in the gi temporal output (smearing); specifically measure whether temporal WIDENS the halo (raw blob x≈1325–1410/y≈720–890 looks tighter than the final ~150 px falloff). Append the classification to notes.md's attribution table. Note: box acceptance must be measured against the re-baselined OFF shot (absolute levels are ~0.6x dimmer than the 2026-09-01 baseline), not the plan's absolute numbers.
result: ENGINE_GI_TEMPORAL=0 re-baseline: temporal contributes <=0.5/255 to every box (denoising only on the speckled eave band) and does NOT widen the halo (dip x~1330-1435 identical in both modes). Classification: halo 100% GI-march / 0% temporal; eave band + sub-band GI-march; cyan cast 100% GI-mix hue / 0% temporal / 0% AO (r1); bounce intended. No gi_temporal.comp tightening needed for task 3. New finding: an R-only band on the lit right wall spans x~1480-1760+, identical in both temporal modes — the wide part of the 'halo' impression; task 3's gate must cover it and it likely shares the cyan cast's R-channel root cause.

desc: PHASE 1 — player halo fix, IN FLIGHT (worker was interrupted mid-task; resume from the 'final — partial-work summary (task 3...)' section of notes.md: v8 of gi_estimate.comp with the four hit-reliability gates is compiled + pak repacked, screenshot /tmp/t3_on_v8.jpg taken, game.log clean). Remaining: (1) run /tmp/t3_diff.py /tmp/t3_on_v8.jpg and iterate v9+ if the halo-dip (x~1330-1435 torso) or R-band (x~1480-1760+ lit right wall) boxes are still >3/255 per channel vs /tmp/ssgi_off.jpg; (2) ENGINE_GI_TEMPORAL=0 v8 capture + diff — acceptance must hold in BOTH temporal modes; (3) bounce check: shadowed-wall boxes must stay brighter than ENGINE_GI_INTENSITY=0 (not just vs disabled); (4) decide the fate of the T3AB ablation define in gi_estimate.comp (remove, or keep + document) BEFORE task 4 builds on the file; (5) full ./scripts/build.sh pass (iterations used bare glslc via /tmp/t3_build.sh); (6) append a '## round 3' notes.md entry with acceptance numbers and the 'intended residue' record (which part of the ~22% ambient drop is kept 1/d^2 character occlusion) for the user scope call. Attribution context: 100% GI-march, 0% temporal, 0% AO — NO gi_temporal.comp tightening; R-only band likely shares a root cause with task 5's cyan cast — note in the round-3 entry whether the same gate/bias term explains both. Acceptance: halo dip + R-band box deltas <=3/255 per channel with temporal on AND off (vs the task-1 re-baselined OFF), bounce light on shadowed walls still brighter than ENGINE_GI_INTENSITY=0. SCOPE NOTE (manager): plan's acceptance bar (halo <=3/255 vs OFF) is authoritative; record which part of the residual survives the gate as 'intended' in notes.md so the user can invert this phase if they want character ambient shadows.

Eave band + contact line + roof-apex fix, routed by task 1 attribution (now partially resolved — mixed routing): (a) contact line (~85% AO: ON−AO1 +8.8/+11/+9.2) and roof apex (~100% AO: ON−AO1 +5.4, AO1−OFF ≈ 0) go the AO route — tune ENGINE_GI_AO_SCALE's default or make the attenuation confidence-driven in VulkanGiPass::aoAttenuationUpdate, document the choice in VulkanGiPass.h's knob block; (b) the eave band main body (~75% GI-march) goes the march route — normal regularization at the wall-top depth discontinuity and/or horizon-aware (cos-weighted over unoccluded directions) sky fallback in gi_estimate.comp, without brightening the correctly-occluded sub-band (CAVEAT: the plan's dark −3R sub-band at 80–100px did NOT reproduce at the current baseline — it measures +8.0R left / −1.3R right, so 'sub-band stays as measured' must be re-defined against the task-1 re-baseline before acceptance). Targeted box check for the roof-apex +R vs sky; small depth-edge bias at the contact test if needed. Acceptance: top-strip box delta <=3/255, sub-band unchanged from task-1 re-baseline, shadowed walls brighter than ENGINE_GI_INTENSITY=0.

Phase 3 — cyan cast: audit the scene.frag GI/IBL mix (IBL scaled by (1-w), GI term pre-scaled to the same ambient class: /PI, kD). Task 1 already sized the CACAO coupling: it is ~0 (cyan cast AO1−OFF bit-equals ON−OFF at −3.0/+0.2/+3.2), so this is a pure GI-mix hue fix (suspect: second-order Jensen bias from mean_cw[E(dir)] vs E(N)); the cast is on the LIT right wall, the shadowed left wall shows the intended bounce lift. Acceptance: lit-wall cyan box delta <=3/255 per channel (measured vs the task-1 re-baselined OFF, not the 2026-09-01 numbers), wall hue within a few degrees of the OFF shot, shadowed-wall bounce preserved.

Phase 5 — regression & sign-off: full A/B protocol (grid flat <=2/255 outside intended bounce regions), ENGINE_GI_TEMPORAL=0 and ENGINE_GI_RAYS=4/6/16 and ENGINE_GI_INTENSITY=0.5/1/2 all clean, one clean ./scripts/run.sh log run (no validation errors), RenderDoc frame if the dispatch pipeline changed; then hand the moving-camera orbit check to the user (parked camera must not be moved).
